Aln'sharan is a cloud serpent that patrols high above Harandar. It is believed that he was the goddess Aln'hara's pet before her disappearance from Harandar. When the goddess disappeared, Aln'sharan retreated high into the roots of Harandar out of sorrow. Rumor holds that the skyglass shards that fall throughout Harandar come from Aln'sharan, being either his shed scales or his tears. The Echo of Aln'sharan mount is obtained by collecting 500 Mysterious Skyshards, bringing them to Kuri at Har'kuai to gain the buff, and then interacting with Aln'sharan.

Altars of Pa'ku are objects located in multiple places in Dazar'alor. They are shrines dedicated to the loa Pa'ku. There are shrines dedicated to other loas as well, and they all share basic features. Altars of Pa'ku are identified by a narrow jaw on the decorative head, a teal plate, and a symbol of a pterrordax with a raised wing. Some shrines are non-interactable, in which case the symbol on the plate is not present. Picking a Side must be completed before the shrine can be used. Interacting with a shrine grants Boon of Pa'ku. When playing as a Zandalari troll it grants Embrace of Pa'ku.

Amani Lapis is a raw gem crafting reagent used in Midnight Jewelcrafting. Amani Lapis may be found when Midnight Prospecting Refulgent Copper Ore, Brilliant Silver Ore, Umbral Tin Ore, or Dazzling Thorium. They can also be looted from a School of Gems, which is created with Midnight Alchemy. 5 Amani Lapis need to be interacted with Camberon's Cauldron to learn the recipe for School of Gems.

Amarehz, more commonly known as Rehze, is the daughter of Go'el (Thrall) and Aggralan (Aggra), and the younger sister of Durak. She takes after her mother, both in appearance and in her fierce and thoughtful manners. Her father affectionately calls her "Little Bug".
